objectives.objective: Preserve and integrate all valid V2 content.
objectives.exit: Every baseline concept, property, constraint, domain and valid later decision has a versioned preservation/migration disposition; omissions or retirement require scientific rationale and explicit author disposition, not a smaller release cut.

objectives.objective: Review isolated concepts and domains and connect them through justified semantics.
objectives.exit: Every active concept has a justified path within its declared module and appropriate cross-domain function, or an explicitly reviewed exception; every bridge has source/requirement, typed ends, identity/dependence/temporal treatment and positive/negative witnesses. A connected graph alone cannot pass.

objectives.objective: Identify and disposition model, requirement, mapping and evaluation gaps.
objectives.exit: All 83 historical ORSD IDs and subsequent requirements are reconciled with the current assembly; accepted mandatory requirements have current-target evidence, all other gaps have reasoned dispositions; mappings and evaluation claims identify exact versions, limits and remaining unknowns.

objectives.objective: Make documentation and diagrams represent that same complete model.
objectives.exit: Native model, formal projections, profile admission rules, domain/overview diagrams, Wiki, Pages reference, WebVOWL, downloads and release manifest share one exact governed model version and coverage crosswalk; filtered views disclose omissions and cannot stand in for the complete inventory.

release_gates.name: Full V2 preservation and governed assembly
required_evidence: Complete concept/property/constraint/domain/decision migration crosswalk
One deterministic versioned assembly manifest
Review S-04/S-05 against comprehensive scope; preserve all prior history
Protect later FacilityOperation/ContextClass/EvidenceRecord decisions during integration

release_gates.name: Semantic domain coherence and justified connections
required_evidence: Current full-model topology plus individually justified isolate/module dispositions
Mission and ownership review of all 17 original domains and any accepted additions
Relation decisions and cross-domain scenario witnesses/counterexamples
Specific review of the 49 older experimental relations and three added classes; no bulk acceptance

release_gates.name: Requirements and source/data mapping reconciliation
required_evidence: All 83 original IDs and later requirements traced to current-target contracts, evidence and dispositions
Accepted mandatory requirements pass their fixed oracles
All baseline field/RDB mappings, scoped M1-M4 migrations and source semantics reconciled without inflated full-data claims
Frozen held-out first-pass results preserved; new prospective evidence separately versioned

release_gates.name: Formal, native and scientific validation
required_evidence: Applicable native input fidelity and supported detector coverage with honest limits
Source-policy dispositions under315; unknown/null fields retained until evidence or an explicit validation route resolves them
OWL consistency and concrete-class satisfiability; SHACL, temporal, cross-module and negative/mutation regression
Real scientific/author disposition required by retained306/310 gates; no invented expert results

release_gates.name: Same-complete-model documentation and publication QA
required_evidence: Exact source/manifest binding for each projection and complete class/relation/domain coverage
Overview and domain diagrams; no undocumented omissions by filtering or export
Wiki/Pages/WebVOWL/download/citation navigation with rendered public QA after acceptance
Applicable original211/213/244 acceptance criteria or explicitly approved dispositions retained

release_gates.name: Compatibility, support and reproducible full-model release
required_evidence: M1 2.1.0 compatibility regression and explicit full-V2 migration/support contract
All mandatory full-model release blockers resolved; no silent reduction to one profile
Pinned licenses/notices and citations, deterministic package, cold replay, downloaded-byte verification
Exact accepted assembly tag and public documentation alignment; no date inferred from packet counts

validity_rule: Preserve valid content and proven decisions. Reassess questionable or previously deferred items against the full objective. An invented bridge, guessed cardinality or silent removal cannot establish coherence.
version_rule: 2.2 is the authorized target while compatibility can be preserved; any genuinely incompatible commitment requires a separate evidenced version decision, not an automatic jump to3.0.
